sections.text:
Perspiration relieves all symptoms except
headache. Chill between 7 and 9 a. m., preceded by
thirst with great soreness and aching of hones. Nausea,

drink enough.

of extremities wit,h soreness of flesh. Aching in arms
and wrists. Swelling of left great toe. Gouty soreness


and inflammed nodosities of joints, associated with head-
ache. Dropsical swelling.
